statements.text: SELECT table_name FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE NOT temporary AND NOT internal AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
PRAGMA table_info("orders")

SELECT constraint_type, constraint_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'orders'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts" FROM "orders" LIMIT 1000
PRAGMA table_info("users")

SELECT constraint_type, constraint_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'users'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
SELECT "user_id", "age", "country" FROM "users" LIMIT 1000

SELECT constraint_index, referenced_table,
       constraint_column_names, referenced_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'orders'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
  AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

SELECT constraint_index, referenced_table,
       constraint_column_names, referenced_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'users'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
  AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "orders"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "users"
SELECT table_name, expressions FROM duckdb_indexes()

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as min_date,
  MAX(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as max_date
FROM "orders"

SELECT "user_id"
FROM (SELECT * FROM "users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL)
USING SAMPLE reservoir(10000 ROWS) REPEATABLE (42)

SELECT s."batch" AS "__kumo_batch__", t."price", t."ts"
FROM "__sdm_seeds__" s
JOIN "orders" t
  ON t."user_id" = s."key"
 AND CAST(t."ts" AS TIMESTAMP) <= s."end"
 AND CAST(t."ts" AS TIMESTAMP) > s."start"

SELECT s."batch" AS "__kumo_batch__", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY s."batch") AS "__kumo_matches__", t."user_id", t."age", t."country"
FROM "__sdm_seeds__" s
JOIN "users" t
  ON t."user_id" = s."key"
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY s."batch"
) = 1

SELECT s."batch" AS "__kumo_batch__", t."order_id", t."user_id", t."price", t."ts"
FROM "__sdm_seeds__" s
JOIN "orders" t
  ON t."user_id" = s."key"
 AND CAST(t."ts" AS TIMESTAMP) <= s."time"
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY s."batch"
  ORDER BY CAST(t."ts" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, t."order_id" ASC NULLS LAST
) <= 32
ORDER BY s."batch", CAST(t."ts" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC NULLS LAST, t."order_id" ASC NULLS LAST
